# Tender Response -- KMK-2026-03

Visakoivu Oy submits the following response.

Visakoivu holds a valid LUSA qualification and maintains NMSB 7310, NMSB 74210, NMSB 75310 and NMSB 78410 certification, and meets the turnover requirement set out in the invitation.

## Technical

The asset register and associated documentation will be handed over at the start of the contract and kept current via quarterly updates.

Building envelope condition (roofing, facades, windows) is inspected annually by visual survey. After any equipment replacement or repair, the work is commissioned and function-tested and signed off by the site technician. Warranty on installed equipment and replacement parts: 24 months, parts and labour.

## Commercial

Invoicing: monthly.

Pricing basis: per property, EUR/month, applied consistently throughout this quotation.

Visakoivu looks forward to the opportunity to work with Koskimyllyn Kiinteistot Oy.
